categories.description: Mobile carrier bill-payment + account-history signals. Any telco vendor (Celcom, Maxis, DiGi, U-Mobile, etc.) implementing this category produces the same canonical field set.

fields.name: telcoOnTimePaymentRatio24m
fields.description: Fraction of bills paid on time over the last 24 months. Strongest single telco predictor; ≥0.95 is the clean-history signal.

fields.name: telcoTenureMonths
fields.description: Account age. ≥48 months is the thin-file uplift trigger.

fields.name: telcoSuspensionsCount24m
fields.description: Non-payment-driven account suspensions in the last 24 months. ≥3 is a strong distress signal.

fields.name: telcoLateDays24m
fields.description: Cumulative days late across all bills in the trailing 24-month window.

fields.name: telcoHandsetFinancingActive
fields.description: Has an active handset-EMI account currently. Proxy for financing capacity already extended.

fields.name: telcoHandsetFinancingDelinquent
fields.description: Recent handset-EMI delinquency in the last 24 months. Distress signal even with otherwise clean bill payment.

fields.name: telcoArpuMyr
fields.description: Average Revenue Per User (monthly) in Malaysian Ringgit. Coarse spending-capacity proxy.

categories.description: Merchant-side payment-flow signals from POS / gateway networks (iPay88, GHL, etc.). Captures actual transaction velocity rather than self-reported revenue.

fields.name: paymentsMonthlyVolumeMyrT3
fields.description: Mean monthly inbound transaction volume (RM) over the trailing 3 months.

fields.name: paymentsMonthlyVolumeMyrT12
fields.description: Mean monthly inbound transaction volume (RM) over the trailing 12 months. Pair with T3 for trend direction.

fields.name: paymentsArpuStability12m
fields.description: Coefficient-of-variation inverse over monthly ARPU in the trailing 12 months. Closer to 1 = steadier; closer to 0 = volatile.

fields.name: paymentsDisputeRate12m
fields.description: Fraction of transactions disputed or refunded in the trailing 12 months.

fields.name: paymentsCustomerConcentrationTop5Pct
fields.description: Revenue share from the top-5 recurring customers. Above ~0.7 is concentration risk.

fields.name: paymentsActiveTenureMonths
fields.description: Months since first transaction on the payment network. Establishment / continuity proxy.

categories.description: Per-month bank-statement extractions. Naturally multi-instance: one statement per (account, month). Eval components typically aggregate across instances (sum closing balance, max debit, count of bounced transactions).

fields.name: bankStatementMonth
fields.description: Statement period in YYYY-MM format. Used as the instance_key discriminator + by the `latest` aggregation operator.

fields.name: bankClosingBalanceMyr
fields.description: Closing balance for the statement period.

fields.name: bankTotalCreditsMyr
fields.description: Sum of credit transactions during the period.

fields.name: bankTotalDebitsMyr
fields.description: Sum of debit transactions during the period.

fields.name: bankLargestSingleCreditMyr
fields.description: Largest single inbound transaction in the period. Useful for spotting one-off injections vs steady revenue.

fields.name: bankBouncedTransactionsCount
fields.description: Bounced / returned transactions in the period. Distress signal at counts > 0.

categories.description: Public business-presence signals from social / commerce platforms — establishment, reach, engagement authenticity, customer reputation, and account standing. Vendor-agnostic: any platform exposing a public business profile maps its data to this canonical field set. Useful as thin-file corroboration of a borrower's operating reality where formal financials are sparse.

fields.name: socialAccountTenureMonths
fields.description: Age of the oldest verified public business presence across linked profiles. Establishment / continuity proxy, parallel to telco + payment-network tenure.

fields.name: socialFollowerCount
fields.description: Aggregate audience size across linked public profiles. Coarse reach / scale proxy — gameable on its own, so read alongside socialEngagementRate90d.

fields.name: socialEngagementRate90d
fields.description: Mean interactions per impression over the trailing 90 days. Authenticity signal: a large follower count with near-zero engagement indicates a bought or dormant audience.

fields.name: socialPostingConsistency12m
fields.description: Fraction of weeks in the trailing 12 months with at least one public post. Ongoing-operation signal — distinguishes an active business from a stale listing.

fields.name: socialVerifiedBusinessAccount
fields.description: Has at least one platform-verified business / commerce profile. Legitimacy signal — the platform has performed its own business-identity check.

fields.name: socialCustomerRatingAvg
fields.description: Mean public customer rating (normalised to a 0–5 scale) across review-bearing profiles. Reputation signal; especially predictive for consumer-facing SMEs.

fields.name: socialNegativeSentimentRatio90d
fields.description: Fraction of public mentions / reviews classified as negative over the trailing 90 days. Reputation-risk / distress signal independent of overall rating volume.

fields.name: socialAccountFlags24m
fields.description: Policy strikes, suspensions, or content takedowns across linked profiles in the last 24 months. Distress signal, parallel to telcoSuspensionsCount24m.
